ctx.x: We were going from DesMoines. We just closed a theater in DesMoines. We were going to Minneapolis to open another theater. And we were playing -- but the show -- it was a show. And the Mills Brothers were on the show. And at that -- on that same show was a -- was the Palmer Brothers were singing too with Earl's band. I don't know if you ever heard of them -- singers. Well, they sang with Cab Calloway later. One crippled little boy was with them -- Clarence. And they really sang good, you know. And also Tip, Tap,…
Toe was on that show. Later they called them the Rhythm Kings or something like that. But they were on the show.
(Unintelligible) The other Palmer Brothers names? Besides Clarence.
